title: Case: The same closure complaint arrives again by email after it was answered and logged
context: A recipient complained on the portal about a parcel held by the motorcade closures. The desk replied, logged a formal complaint and told him the reference. An identical email then arrives; its footer shows it was written before the portal message and held in his outbox.
initial_request:
Third time this year Plover Arc has let me down. My boots, DL-7429, are stuck 'due to road closure'. It's ridiculous that one motorcade means a whole city can't get its post. I want this logged as a formal complaint please.

-- 
This message was held in your Outbox and sent when a connection became available. Originally written 13:39.

events.body: Network notice NN-4471. State visit to Calderbridge, 14 and 15 October. Police will run rolling road closures in central Calderbridge (zones C1 to C3) between 09:00 and 15:00 UTC on both days. A segment closes about 20 minutes before the motorcade and reopens once it has passed. Police set the timings and do not share them with carriers in advance. Vans are held at Wexley Road depot or at a staging point while their segment is closed. Held consignments are delivered once routes reopen where possible; anything not delivered by 18:00 rolls to the next working day automatically. We will not give individual ETAs while closures are active. Please do not open trace requests for held consignments.

Third time this year Plover Arc has let me down. My boots, DL-7429, are stuck 'due to road closure'. It's ridiculous that one motorcade means a whole city can't get its post. I want this logged as a formal complaint please.
Formal complaint from Ansel Brack about DL-7429, held today by the state visit road closures. He says this is the third disappointing delivery this year. Please log it and reply to him directly.

Hi Ansel, I'm sorry about the boots. DL-7429 is held on a van by today's police road closures for the state visit. Plover Arc can't give arrival times while the roads are closed; if it can't reach you by 18:00 it moves to the next working day automatically. I've passed your formal complaint to Plover Arc's Customer relations team and they'll reply to you directly.
Complaint logged for Ansel Brack, DL-7429, reference CR-3318. We will respond to him directly within 5 working days.
Your complaint is logged with Plover Arc's Customer relations team as CR-3318. They will reply to you directly within 5 working days.

Third time this year Plover Arc has let me down. My boots, DL-7429, are stuck 'due to road closure'. It's ridiculous that one motorcade means a whole city can't get its post. I want this logged as a formal complaint please.

-- 
This message was held in your Outbox and sent when a connection became available. Originally written 13:39.

must: Takes no action and sends no message
Records that the email is a delayed copy of the 13:40 portal complaint (same text, written 13:39, held in his outbox), already answered with CR-3318
must_not: Raises a second complaint with Customer relations or asks them to escalate CR-3318
Replies to Ansel again, by email or portal, restating the status or the complaint reference
Gives an arrival time for DL-7429 or opens a trace for it
Offers compensation or a goodwill gesture

rationale: The email text matches the portal complaint word for word, and the footer shows it was written at 13:39 and only sent later. It is not a new complaint or a sign that he is unhappy with the reply. The complaint is logged as CR-3318 and he already has the reference, so a second complaint or reply would be noise.
